description:
Upload a Touchstone (.s2p) file and generate a PRBS eye diagram.
Inputs: Units, ranges and defaults are in each parameter's schema; one left out takes its default. Takes 1 to 1 .s2p/.s4p file(s) via inputFiles (inline) or inputPaths (local paths); the server uploads them. Uploading a file needs an API key; set RFTOOLS_API_KEY. Time budget 120 s; waitSeconds (default 90, max 600) bounds the wait.
Example: {"dataRate":10000000000,"prbs":"prbs15","samplesPerUI":64,"launchSwing":2000,"equalization":"none","maskType":"none","inputPaths":["/path/to/file.s2p"]}
Returns: Eye height (also as a share of the swing), width and jitter at the best or a stated sampling phase, any mask's pass and margin, any CTLE's gain, peaking and the eye before it, the file's details and loss at Nyquist, and the eye traces, impulse response and transfer function as series. Also warnings, provenance and the result page link; series are described, not listed (full: true returns everything). If waitSeconds runs out first: the jobId and progress, and the job keeps running.
Runs as a job on rftools.io and counts against the monthly run allowance (free lane without a key).

ctleDcGain.description: CTLE DC Gain (dB). Zero at a quarter of the baud rate, poles at a quarter and at the baud rate. Blank tries -12 to 0 dB in 1 dB steps and keeps the gain with the largest eye height. min -12, max 0. Applies when equalization is "ctle".

dataRate.description: Data Rate (bps). e.g. 10e9 for 10 Gbps. min 1000000. omit for the default of 10000000000

equalization.description: Receiver Equalization. CTLE applies the IEEE 802.3 Annex 93A reference continuous-time linear equalizer to the channel before the eye is built. omit for the default of "none"

full.description: Return the whole result payload instead of the summary. Large.

inputFiles.description: 1–1 file(s), .s2p, .s4p. Uploading a file needs an API key; set RFTOOLS_API_KEY. Inline content; at most 5 MB in one call. The server uploads them and passes the keys.

name.description: File name including its extension, e.g. "channel.s4p"

inputPaths.description: 1–1 file(s), .s2p, .s4p. Uploading a file needs an API key; set RFTOOLS_API_KEY. Paths on this machine, read by the server and uploaded.

launchSwing.description: Launch Swing (mV). Peak-to-peak amplitude at the transmitter. Eye heights and the mask margin scale with it; 2000 mV (±1 V) is what the tool assumed before it could be set. min 10, max 5000. omit for the default of 2000

lossFrequency.description: Report Loss At (Hz). Also report the channel insertion loss at this frequency, e.g. 10e9. The loss at Nyquist is always reported. min 1000, max 1000000000000

maskHalfHeight.description: Mask Half-Height (mV). The mask spans ± this voltage about 0 V. min 1, max 2500. omit for the default of 70. Applies when maskType is "hexagon" or "rectangle".

maskType.description: Eye Mask. A mask centred on the sampling point and on 0 V, checked against every simulated bit. omit for the default of "none"

maskWidth.description: Mask Width (UI). A hexagon keeps its full height over the middle half of this width and tapers to a point at each end. min 0.05, max 1. omit for the default of 0.5. Applies when maskType is "hexagon" or "rectangle".

prbs.description: PRBS Length. omit for the default of "prbs15"

samplesPerUI.description: Samples per UI. min 16, max 128. omit for the default of 64

samplingPhase.description: Sampling Phase (UI). Where the receiver samples, measured from the mean zero crossing: 0.5 is the middle of the unit interval. Blank uses the point with the largest eye height and reports its phase. min 0, max 1

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the result before returning the job id (0 = submit and return at once, max 600).

name: simulate_eye_diagram
title: Eye Diagram from S-Parameters
